services.name: Dive trip
services.desc: The Perris Skydiving Program is different from every other “learn to skydive” training program in the country. As one of the largest and most well-equipped skydiving dropzones on the planet - including one of only a handful worldwide with an on-site wind tunnel - we have the unique opportunity to provide a superior level of training that yields self-sufficient skydivers. Ready to learn from the best? Learn more about the PSP, or jump in and get started! The Perris Skydiving Program represents the way skydiving should be taught. It encompasses a rich blend of independent learning, in-person instruction, and practical training in both indoor and outdoor skydiving settings. By program
